premises: Increasing atomic size mismatch in AlCoCrFeNi-based HEAs increases local lattice distortions.
Increased local lattice distortions impede dislocation motion.
Impeding dislocation motion delays plastic deformation and reduces shear band/microcrack formation during wear.
This mechanism can be isolated from other microstructural changes (phase, stoichiometry, thermal history) by controlled processing and characterization.
